blocks.text: Software development computer programs banane ka process hai, aise programs jo khaas kaam (specific tasks) karne ke liye banaye jate hain. Is mein code likhna, us ko test karna aur jo masle (issues) samne aayein un ko hal karna shamil hai. Software development is liye aham hai ke yeh masle hal karta hai aur hamari zindagi aasan banata hai. Misal ke taur par software ki madad se hum social media par doston se baat karte hain, banking apps se apne paise sambhalte hain, aur educational games se seekhna mazedar ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Do rozmarra misalein dein jo dikhayein ke software development kyun aham hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: social media apps se doston se baat hoti hai; banking apps paise sambhalne mein madad karti hain; educational games seekhna mazedar banati hain.

items: Software development: khaas kaam karne wale programs banana: code likhna, test karna, masle hal karna.
Aham kyun: masle hal karta hai aur zindagi aasan banata hai (social media, banking apps, educational games).
